 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Luka Doncic has made all the headlines for the Los Angeles Lakers, but Austin Reaves has been fantastic as well. 
 The Slovenian has been producing MVP-level numbers, and as things stand, he is the favourite to win that award ahead of Victor Wembanyama this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Doncic deserves praise, but Reaves should get a lot of credit too. Skip Bayless has heaped praise on him now and has made a very bold claim.
 Skip Bayless says Austin Reaves is the best undrafted player in NBA history
 Reaves went undrafted in the first round of the 2021 NBA draft.
 In the second round, the guard declined to join the Detroit Pistons, with his agents informing them and other franchises that he'd rather go undrafted and pick his own team as a free agent.
 Right after the draft ended, Reaves joined the Los Angeles Lakers on a two-way contract, before earning a standard NBA deal ahead of his rookie season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bayless has been very impressed with Reaves over the years, and he has now given him a very interesting title, while speaking on the Double Coverage Podcast .
 He said: "Austin Reaves has to be the best undrafted NBA player in history. And I've looked at the list of undrafteds who made it and became sort of quasi stars.
 "Austin Reaves is at the top of the list because, as JJ Redick said last year early in the year when there was no LeBron and no Luka, and remember he was scoring 50, JJ said he's a bad m***********.
 "He is. Austin Reaves is a bad m***********, like a legit NBA scorer."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Reaves definitely deserves all the praise in the world, and there is a legitimate argument to be made that he is the best undrafted player in the history of the NBA.
 However, the likes of Ben Wallace, Fred VanVleet, John Starks and Brad Miller are all in the conversation as well, and their resumes and accolades currently trump Reaves.
 That being said, if Reaves continues to perform at this level, he could surpass the above names by the time he finishes his career.
